steps._comment: == DAY, the ship-neutral contract. Identity grade AND no biome-default emitter: every sky-bearing biome's default is gated to dusk/night precisely so this frame stays byte-identical to the pre-wave one. ==

#608 art read: invrisil_street dropped its biome dust-mote default (motes with no source over a lamp-lit street), so the boulevard builds no emitter at any phase. The day-identity tooth (v0.17 fix wave, finding #2/#9) moved to Liscor's street leg below.
== EMITTER GATE on a still-emitting sky map. A teleport to Liscor's street and straight back to the start cell: no screenshot is taken there, and every shot below keeps its route and framing.

DAY IS IDENTITY, asserted rather than eyeballed (v0.17 fix wave, finding #2/#9), on a map that still exercises the gate. #608 dropped invrisil_street's biome default, so the tooth moved to Liscor's `street`: biome `street` defaults to dust motes and the map has a sky, so the emitter is BUILT (`emitters: 1`) and `emitting` must read 0 at noon. This bites if a sky-bearing map ever drifts particles through a noon frame.
